question: Why does the best bound soul not abandon firm attachment?
premises: the best bound soul stationed in Vama does not abandon firmly
Shiva alone conceals and places him
this occurs by force of order
inference: concealment and placement by Shiva bind the soul despite its firmness
plain_english: It is said he does not abandon firmly; the best bound soul stationed in Vama is concealed and placed by Shiva alone, by force of order.
